# Foundational Bio

> Foundational Bio builds self-driving biology labs: physical AI for the life sciences. Physical AI models drive robots to do all the hands-on lab work, so samples become data without a human touching them. The company runs its own AI-native, vertically integrated lab in New York and offers sequencing as a service. Tagline: "Tell the lab what to do, not how to do it."

For research use only (RUO). Not for use in diagnostic procedures.

## What we do

- Build and operate autonomous, AI-native biology labs 
- Offer next-generation sequencing as a repeatable service: send a plate, get back data
- Designed to reduce cost, turnaround time, and errors compared with manual lab work
- Long-term: deploy the same lab system into other labs once proven at scale

## Why

AI is rapidly accelerating hypothesis generation, experiment design, and interpretation. Generating the data in between still depends on a person with a pipette. Lab work is expensive, slow, and error-prone, and hiring more hands does not fix it. Foundational Bio is building a lab where the bench keeps up, so scientists spend their time on science, not manual labor.

## How the lab works

Four layers, built together as one system. Inside the lab, only robots touch samples.

1. Intent: human + AI scientist. Hypothesis, experimental design, and evaluation. The customer decides what to run.
2. Translation: software platform. Turns intent into protocols, orchestrates runs, and collects data.
3. Execution: physical AI models. Execute wet-lab protocols on real hardware.
4. Infrastructure: scalable lab hardware. Modular, AI-native workstations; capacity grows one unit at a time.

Full traceability: every action on every sample is machine-executed and machine-logged, from intake to delivered data.

## Services

- WGS (whole-genome sequencing): available now
- WES (whole-exome sequencing): coming soon
- RNA-seq (transcriptome sequencing): coming soon
- ppmSeq (part-per-million variant detection): coming soon
- Methyl-seq (methylation sequencing): on the roadmap
- Beyond sequencing: shaped with development partners

## Ordering

- Minimum order: 100 samples for 30x human whole-genome sequencing
- Accepted inputs: blood, saliva, or extracted DNA
- Deliverables: CRAM and VCF files
- Request a quote at https://foundational.bio/#book; replies within one business day
- Contact: info@foundational.bio
